protocol: Read-only multilayer decoder parameter-gradient audit. The frozen M95 checkpoint is run with gradients enabled on the 284-bank diagnostic manifest. Each decoder layer's oracle-selection CE and oracle-mask BCE+Dice gradients are compared on its own layer parameters. No training or mechanism admission follows.
limitation: The audit measures local decoder-layer parameter directions on one frozen checkpoint and one validation-derived manifest. It does not establish full-model causality, a deployable selector, or primary-source novelty.
